description.value: Teapressu is a bubble tea cafe in Burnaby offering a variety of tea-based beverages with online ordering for quick takeout. A casual refreshment stop for cyclists passing through the area on Kingsway.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 88m; stands (5 spaces) at 98m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Teapressu is an operational bubble tea cafe with online ordering capability. Phone (778-929-8181) and address (5242 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC) match OSM record. Email discrepancy noted: OSM lists info@teapressu.com but website footer shows info@slothfuls.com, suggesting possible business transition or platform consolidation. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, charging) are mentioned on website.
concerns: Email address discrepancy: OSM lists info@teapressu.com, but website footer shows info@slothfuls.com; may indicate business transition or consolidated messaging platform
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible food/drink establishment with verified website, address, and phone contact. Suitable for touring cyclists seeking quick refreshment stops.
